title: Invocation-Bound Capability Token (IBCT) v0.1
description: AIP-aligned (draft-prakash-aip-00) capability token binding: issuer identity, attenuated scope, parent-token hash, constitutional verdict, and outcome receipt into a single cryptographic artifact. Hard/soft tier annotation enables Cedar-style non-compensatory floor enforcement. Chain hash is SHA-256 over canonical-JSON (RFC 8785 JCS) of the entire object minus the chain_hash field itself.
frozen_reason: v0.1 is the smallest first cut per F13 directive. Subsequent versions MUST be additive (new optional fields only); no breaking changes to existing fields without F13 ratification.

tier.description: Cedar-style tier: hard = non-compensatory (cannot be overridden by any permit), soft = advisory (can be overridden by F13 sovereign)

token_id.description: Unique token identifier. MUST be SHA-256 of the canonical-JSON-serialization of all other fields (excluding token_id itself and audit.chain_hash).

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of token issuance

pubkey_ref.description: Path to issuer's Ed25519 public key (PEM). Optional if the verifier already knows the issuer's key.

signature_algorithm.description: v0.1 only supports Ed25519. Future versions may add ECDSA-P256 or post-quantum.

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the canonical-JSON serialization of all other token fields (excluding signature itself).

attenuated_scope.description: What the bearer may do. NARROWER than parent_token's scope (attenuation rule). Hard-tier constraints are non-compensatory (cannot be overridden by any permit).

forbidden_actions.description: Explicitly forbidden verbs (overrides any allow). For v0.1, the implementation MUST reject if any executed action appears here.

resource_patterns.description: Glob patterns the bearer may touch (e.g. ['/root/AAA/governance/delegation-ledger/*'])

constraints.description: Hard constraints (tier='hard') are non-compensatory. Soft constraints (tier='soft') are advisory.

additive_only.description: If true, outcome_receipt.files_deleted MUST be empty. Non-compensatory when tier='hard'.

no_destructive_operations.description: If true, no rm/DROP/force-push commands allowed. Non-compensatory when tier='hard'.

require_live_evidence.description: If true, bearer MUST show a passing live test + runnable command for each 'adopted'/'integrated'/'complete' claim.

expiry.description: After this timestamp, the token is VOID regardless of issuer signature.

parent_token_hash.description: sha256 of parent token's chain_hash (or null for root tokens issued directly by F13 sovereign). Attenuation invariant: child scope MUST be subset of parent scope.

constitutional_verdict.description: The constitutional gate decision (per F1-F13 floors). Hard-tier floors cannot be overridden by any permit. Soft-tier floors can be overridden by F13 sovereign only.

constitutional_floors_checked.description: Which F1-F13 floors were checked. Hard-tier floors MUST appear in this list.

floor_violations.description: Empty array = no violations. Non-empty = token MUST be revoked.

cedar_policy_hash.description: sha256 of the Cedar policy that produced this verdict. Optional in v0.1; required in v1.0.

outcome_receipt.description: What actually happened. MUST be filled before token is sealed.

files_created.description: Files created. MUST be empty if attenuated_scope.constraints.additive_only=true and tier='hard'.

files_deleted.description: Files deleted. MUST be empty if attenuated_scope.constraints.additive_only=true.

commands_run.description: Commands executed. MUST NOT contain rm/DROP/force-push if no_destructive_operations=true.

side_effects.description: Human-readable side effects (receipts sealed, services restarted, etc.)

audit.description: Hash chain linking tokens into a tamper-evident ledger. chain_hash = SHA-256(JCS(this minus chain_hash)).

chain_hash.description: SHA-256 over canonical-JSON (RFC 8785 JCS) of all other fields in this token (excluding chain_hash itself).

chain_index.description: Sequential index in the chain (0 = root).

parent_chain_hash.description: Same as parent_token_hash (denormalized for hash-chain verification convenience).

ledger_root.description: Merkle root of all chain_hashes in the lineage. v0.1 stores it for forward-compatibility; v1.0 will verify against it.
